It is said that even when war broke out between humanity and the gods, he did not permit the seal to be broken.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Negates all status ailments, 60% boost to Def, max HP, 50% Spark damage reduction, 50% additional damage reduction & probability of resistance against 1 KO attack
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A crystal imbued with divine energies by a monk on a pilgrimage in another world. The monk is said to have visited extreme environments inaccessible to normal individuals in this quest in order to gather divine energy. Though accounts linger across the land even now, the earliest and latest written accounts span over one thousand years. Some scholars contend that the crystal's power may have extended the monk's life for such a duration.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: 80% boost to max HP, activates at turn's end BB gauge boost each turn effect at turn's start instead, enormously boosts BB gauge each turn, 20% damage reduction for 1 turn when damage dealt exceeds certain amount & negates critical and elemental damage for 2 turns when damage taken exceeds certain amount
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A scourge believed to have been used to punish prisoners in the Agni Empire. As all of these prisoners died with peaceful expressions on their faces, in time it came to be revered as a sacred object. However, it was later discovered that the whip was a profane relic that heightens suffering and madness in those it strikes. It was then promptly sealed away, deep underground. One theory holds that a certain queen was involved in the whip's creation.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: 150% boost to Spark damage, Spark damage boosts BB gauge and restores HP & adds probable Spark critical, slight reduction to damage from all types and considerably boosts Spark damage for 1 turn when Sparks exceeds certain amount
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: The legends of one world tell us that there once was an archer who excelled in rapid-fire, point-blank combat. It was said that she could fire at an enemy locked in combat with an ally in a chaotic melee, and always strike only the enemy without fail. She only grew more accurate with each foe she slew, and she left the battlefield strewn with a corpse for each arrow she carried. As she put it, so long as she had a trusted friend to work with, she could slay any foe.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: 60% boost to all parameters, 10% damage reduction & negates critical and elemental damage
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: Heavenly robes bestowed upon a shrine maiden who was deeply connected to the gods in ancient times. The robes hold the power to make any who wear them into a divine being, and those with strong spiritual faith are said to gain the same awareness as the gods. In time, the shrine maiden awoke to some unknown truth and departed, never to be seen again. Since that time, a goddess virtually indistinguishable from the shrine maiden's description has appeared to rescue humans from grand disasters.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Enormously boosts BB Atk, hugely boosts elemental damage, hugely boosts critical damage, 200% boost to Atk & raises max Atk value from 99999 to 200000
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A legendary demon blade said to be able to bring down any massive foe in a single strike. It is said that even a scratch from its blade will instantly devour life force from the wound, earning it the nickname "Death's Blade." It is also said that the blade secretly draws its power from numerous demons sealed within it, and that one can faintly hear an eerie, hair-raising wailing when it is nearby.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Considerably boosts critical hit rate, hugely boosts critical damage, 30% boost to all parameters & boosts elemental damage
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: This Sphere was developed at the Summoners' Research Lab, but Noel restricted the disclosure of information on it due to the magnitude of its powers. It holds the power to greatly enhance its bearer's destructive capacity, but advanced skills are required to make full use of its abilities. Bearers were unable to control its power in tests, and many are said to have injured themselves.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: 45% boost to all parameters, boosts all elemental damage & hugely boosts BC, HC drop rates
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A precious stone very rarely discovered in the depths of a certain world. It is believed to be created from the crystallization over many long years of the power that circulates through that world. It is said to considerably enhance the potential of those who touch it, and enable them ascertain the many different elements and flows of power that make up the world. Furthermore, some among them are said to even understand their own destiny that awaits them.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: 120% boost to Spark damage, 20% boost to Spark damage for 3 turns when Sparks exceed certain amount & considerably boosts critical damage
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A halberd believed to have been created by the war god Diacles in order to destroy opposing gods. It absorbed the gods destroyed by Diacles, and even now is said to contain their power. Since many different divine powers are mixed together, it is considered to be extremely difficult to wield, but it also has the ability to resonate with any kind of power, and can amplify its force considerably.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Raises max Atk value from 99999 to 150000, considerably boosts BB Atk & boosts Atk, Def, Rec when BB gauge is over 50%
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A sword said to have been created from the gathered light of stars by ancient gods long ago. Any who takes hold of it is said to be able to display great strength beyond what would be considered their limits. Some believe that, were it wielded by a divine being, it could destroy many worlds in one fell swoop. Upon realizing the sword's destructive power, which far exceeded expectations, it's believed the gods decided to seal it away on a distant world known to no one.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Probable Paralysis effect, 30% boost to Atk & boosts damage against status afflicted foes
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: This blade was made from materials gained from the wicked dragon Avlansch, who was created out of concentrated water magic by Natra, the deity of shadow. With its flowing curves and clear blue-white blade, many who look upon it are struck with awe. But the blade still holds the evil spirit of Avlansch despite its beautiful appearance. Accordingly, it is said to have the terrifying power to paralyze anyone it cuts via its inherent freezing temperature.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: 攻撃力・最大ＨＰを２０％アップ＆ＨＰが半分以下の時、攻撃力をアップ＆弱点属性ダメージをアップ
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: 異界で活躍する英雄クローディアの愛剣。神々の加護を受けた聖剣を、彼女自らがあらためて鍛え直したもの。その力は凄まじく、水にさらせば流れる羊毛は絡まず真っ二つに断ってしまい、振り下ろせば金床石すら砕いてしまうとされ、邪龍の鋼の鱗をいとも簡単に斬り裂き屠ってしまうほどの切れ味と破壊力を誇ると伝えられている。

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: ターン毎にＢＢゲージを増加＆攻撃力を２０％アップ＆ＢＣ・ＨＣ出現率をアップ
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: 異界で活躍する英雄クローディアの愛槍。聖剣バルムンクとほぼ同等の力を持っているとされ、戦いの際、クローディアはこの聖槍とバルムンクの２つの聖なる武器を常に所持し、双方を巧みに駆使しながら主君に仇なす者たちをすべて薙ぎ払って行った。この聖槍から繰り出された一撃は、いかなる魔獣をも屠ったと伝えられている。

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: 防御力・最大ＨＰを２０％アップ＆全状態異常を無効＆攻撃力・防御力・回復力を低下する効果を無効
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: 異界に存在する四天竜の骸から作られたとされる鎧。最強の名を冠する４体の竜を全て討伐した者のみが装着できるとされており、灼熱や極寒などあらゆる過酷な環境に対応することができるという伝説の逸品である。一説によれば異界においてこの鎧を装着することは、異界の魔獣を制したことを意味すると言われている。

2C7LDzYk.c7Z6xDB2: 妖剣ダーインスレイヴ
2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: 確率で全状態異常をランダムに発生＆攻撃力を２０％アップ＆ＢＣ獲得時の増加量を少しアップ
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: 異界に君臨する伝説の竜を討伐した者だけが使用できるとされる妖剣。一振りで魔物の大軍を薙ぎ払うほどの威力を持つが、その刀身には邪悪な思念が宿っているという。その思念に飲み込まれた者は千の魔物を斬るまで剣を手放せなくなると言われており、よほどの手練でなければ自我を保ちつつ扱いこなすことはできないだろう。

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: 被ダメージを５％軽減＆防御貫通効果を無効＆防御力を２０％アップ
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: 聖天使長ヴェヒターが光の神より授けられた杖。天使長の象徴としての意味合いもあったが、極めて強力な装備であり、守りにおいては使用者の意思に先駆けて防御結界を展開し、攻めにおいては複数の魔力弾を同時に放つ能力を発揮した。更にかつて天使長の手元にあった頃は、簡単な命令は単体でこなすことが可能だったと言われている。

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: スパーク時、ＢＢゲージを少し増加・ダメージを５０％アップ＆スパークが一定数を超える度に３ターン、攻撃力を少しアップ
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: 異界「サンクチュアリ」で活躍する戦士たちの活力と魔力が込められているとされる結晶。元々は平和な世界だったサンクチュアリに、邪悪なる竜が率いる軍勢が突如出現。各地を支配され、世界に悲しみが満ちあふれる。だが平和を取り戻すため、数多くの名もなき戦士たちが立ち上がった。彼らの戦いは今もなお続いているのだという。

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Beacon
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A bullet that applies a special glowing pigment made from an Acute Eye on its target. A Summoner is able to detect the glow even from a distance, thus it is often used among the Demon Slayers when they work in teams. The Demon Slayers are also given a basic gun to fire the bullet, but the gun does not have great range nor power, so it does not inflict any damage on its target.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Smoke Bomb
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A pellet that creates a smoke screen by taking advantage of properties of Smoky Drops. The special smoke not only obstructs one's field of sight, it makes it impossible to detect any scents or traces of magic as well. Unfortunately, as its effects affect the senses of its user as well, it can't be used in ambushes, and is only useful for escape from tough enemies. When faced with a formidable monster, sometimes retreating is the only option.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Teleport
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A catalyst that allows any Summoner to use teleportation magic. However, it does not allow its user to teleport freely, only towards a preset portal and is often used by the Demon Slayers as a means of rapid travel. Although it isn't perfect, the process of creating this potion which produces highly refined magic is only disclosed to a few Summoners and its distribution to the public is strictly restricted.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: God Crystal
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: An extract from the Mow Nut, it was mixed with a Cure and crystallized into an incense. This incense stabilizes the spirit, and has the ability to cure any wounds that the soul itself may have suffered. It has the power to heal Demon Slayers for a short time, but it takes a lot of preparation to burn, and thus an exclusive burner is required. However, any error committed when processing this incense can result in dangerous ingredients, and thus it is not available for common use.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Atk Crystal
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: An extract from the Mow Nut, it was mixed with an Atk Potion, refined, and then crystallized into an incense. The aroma from this incense incites one's fighting spirits, and has the ability to increase one's attack power on the battlefield. Since one mistake when using this incense can lead one to go berserk, the common folk, and the usual Summoner are forbidden to use it. However, due to its effective properties, there are probably Demon Slayers out there at this very moment surrounding an incense burner in order to prepare for the battlefield.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Def Crystal
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: An extract from the Mow Nut, it was mixed with a Def Potion, and crystallized into an incense. Its aroma has the ability to increase one's defensive power. Similar to other crystallized types of incense, when the instructions for its burning are not followed to the letter, it can have a bad effect on the user, and thus permission to use this item is only granted to Demon Slayers currently on duty. Furthermore, the side effect of this crystal is said to be extreme devitalization.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Detector
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: Made by using Brown Grass, the light that this eye shines is amplified to cover a very long distance, making it a catalyst for magic that can very well be considered clairvoyance. The light that it shines has a particular purpose. It can penetrate any object, and stretch over any distance, reflecting off any strong spirits that it encounters. It is said that since this item came into use, Demon Slayers have been able to locate the dens of demons more quickly.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: 10% boost to Def and Rec, 30% boost to max HP, negates Curse, Paralysis, Weak effects & boosts BB gauge fill rate
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A piece of an armor set. It may have been an early prototype of the Six Armors, or a replica based on the same. It has powerful but incomplete defensive abilities.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: 50% boost to Atk, 100% boost to Spark damage, Spark damage slightly boosts BB gauge & negates Curse, Paralysis, Injury effects
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A piece of an armor set, a possible predecessor of the Six Armors. It analyzes enemy behavior, anticipating their attack patterns and weaknesses.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Greatly boosts Spark damage and drop rate of BC and HC
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: Greatly boosts Spark damage and drop rate of BC and HC

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A crystal used to evolve the mock Unit based on Seria
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A crystal that radiates red light. It is an Item required to evolve the mock Unit based on Seria. The memories of the real Seria, who was able to unleash the powers within her by leaving the past behind her and finally moving forward, are sealed within this crystal. This crystal was purified by Noel of the Akras Summoners' Research Lab, and the creature in charge of the Imperial Library, but it seems that more of these are being produced for different mock Units.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A rare crystal used to evolve the mock Unit based on Seria
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A rare crystal that radiates red light. It is an item required to evolve the mock Unit modeled after Seria even further. It is believed to contain her memories of the moment she reconsidered her own power, after settling matters with the Summoner in the wake of their battle with Mora. Noel and Rhynt refined this crystal, and state that even among the numerous mock Units, they had particularly high hopes for Seria's potential for spiritual growth.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A crystal used to evolve the mock Unit based on Karl
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A crystal that radiates blue light. It is an Item required to evolve the mock Unit based on Karl. The memories of the real Karl, who was able to unleash the powers within him thanks to the deep bonds of trust he formed with his friends, are sealed within this crystal. The help of Noel from the Akras Summoners' Hall was enlisted to purify this stone, along with the guidance of the mythical creature in charge of the Imperial Library. Karl has been the first mock Unit to cooperate with the research being conducted about his own self.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A rare crystal used to evolve the mock Unit based on Karl
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A rare crystal that radiates blue light. It is an item required to evolve the mock Unit modeled after Karl even further. It is believed to contain his memories of the time he fought the demon Barion in his true form, faced the truth of his birth, and gained the ability to use demonic powers freely. Noel and Rhynt refined this crystal, though the notorious demon-hater Noel looked displeased throughout the entire process.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A crystal used to evolve the mock Unit based on Lugina
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A crystal that radiates green light. It is an Item required to evolve the mock Unit based on Lugina. The memories of the real Lugina, who was able to realize his own potential anew, are sealed within this crystal. Noel of the Summoners' Research Lab and Rhynt of the Imperial Library purified this stone through their efforts together, though rumor has it Noel was not very keen on this.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A rare crystal used to evolve the mock Unit based on Lugina
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A rare crystal that radiates green light. It is an Item required to evolve the mock Unit modeled after Lugina even further. It is believed to contain his memories of La Veda fencing, which he had sealed away himself and then unsealed upon acknowledging a certain Summoner's powers. Knowledge from Noel and Rhynt was used to refine it, but as one would expect, Noel had no interest in helping. Many unpleasant days ensued.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A crystal used to evolve the mock Unit based on Paris
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A crystal that radiates yellow light.  It is an Item required to evolve the mock Unit based on Paris. The memories of the real Paris, who discovered that the key to her true potential was connected to her own will, are sealed within this crystal. Noel of the Summoners' Research Lab and Rhynt of the Imperial Library purified this stone, and rumor has it they both had a hand in the growth of the real Paris.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A rare crystal used to evolve the mock Unit based on Paris
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A rare crystal that radiates yellow light. It is an Item required to evolve the mock Unit modeled after Paris even further. It is believed to contain memories of the moment Paris reaffirmed her strengths and abilities, and resolved to follow the difficult path she truly wished to. There are rumors that Noel and Rhynt argued over the hairstyle to use when refining this crystal, but no public records exist on the matter.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A crystal used to evolve the mock Unit based on Tilith
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A crystal that radiates prismatic light. It is an item required to evolve the mock Unit modeled after Tilith. The memories of the real Tilith, who was able to unleash the powers within her after a reunion with her beloved friends, are sealed within this crystal. Noel of the Summoners' Research Lab and Rhynt of the Imperial Library purified this stone, which shines brightly, pulsating with the strong will contained within.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A rare crystal used to evolve the mock Unit based on Tilith
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A rare crystal that radiates prismatic light. It is an item required to evolve the mock Unit modeled after Tilith even further. It is believed to contain the memories of the moment Tilith unleashed all of her dormant powers in order to protect her beloved friends during a great crisis. Noel of the Summoners' Research Lab and Rhynt of the Imperial Library purified this stone, which is said to shine brighter than any of the others.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A crystal used to evolve the mock Unit based on Grahdens
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A crystal that radiates purple light. It is an Item required to evolve the mock Unit based on Grahdens. The memories of the real Grahdens, who was able to unleash the powers within him when he decided to face his opponents in battle as a mere Summoner, are sealed within this crystal. Noel of the Summoners' Research Lab and Rhynt of the Imperial Library purified this stone, and though satisfied with the results, they seem bent on perfecting this craft.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A rare crystal used to evolve the mock Unit based on Grahdens
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A rare crystal that radiates purple light. It is an Item required to evolve the mock Unit based on Grahdens even further. The memories of the real Grahdens, who was able to use his great experience to full effect on the battlefield, are sealed within this crystal. Once purified by Noel from the Summoners' Research Lab and Rhynt from the Imperial Library, the softly glistening light curiously does not fade, remaining visible under any conditions.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A rare crystal used to evolve the mock Unit based on Owen
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A rare crystal that radiates dazzling light. It is an Item required to evolve the mock Unit based on Owen even further. The memories of the real Owen, as he passed his conviction and dedication to others, are sealed within this crystal. Noel from the Summoners' Research Lab and Rhynt from the Imperial Library purified this stone. When near the Grand Amethyst, a great heat can be detected within the crystal.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A rare crystal used to evolve the mock Unit based on Ark
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A rare crystal that releases two shining wings. It is an item required to evolve the mock Unit modeled after Ark even further. It is said that it appeared when the pair who had desired for hundreds of years to be reunited finally joined hands. It came into Noel's possession after the Oracle Knight and the Shrine Maiden gave it to a certain Summoner, lighting his face up with a childlike smile befitting of his true age.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A rare crystal used to evolve the mock Unit based on Reda
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A rare crystal that radiates scarlet light. It is an item required to evolve the mock Unit modeled after Reda even further. Just as Reda gathers the fragments of heroes' memories, this crystal is believed to hold the feelings she has experienced upon touching those memories. Rumor holds that Noel and Rhynt of the Summoners' Hall refined this crystal in such a manner that touching it can grant a glimpse of ancient heroes' memories.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A mysterious stone that allows Units to surpass the gods' power
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A mysterious stone of lore that radiates a silver light. According to ancient legend, whoemever comes in possession of the stone will gain the power to surpass the gods. Nowadays the Akras Summoners' Hall has been using this stone as a catalyst to evolve special Units, claiming to have several of the stones in the Hall's possession. This stone is also known to have provided some of the ingredients necessary for the evolution of mock Units.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Multiplies experience by 1.5 after Quest is cleared
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A precious silver token found recently within the Vortex. The blue jewel encrusted in the middle holds powers from another world that when unleashed in battle raise the experience a Summoner can gather. Its beautiful design also makes it quite the valuable item, though once the sealed magic within is activated, the token dissolves instantly.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Multiplies experience by 2 after Quest is cleared
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: An extremely rare gold badge found recently within the Vortex. The red jewel encrusted in the middle holds powers from another world that when unleashed in battle greatly raise the experience a Summoner can gather. The precious and lustrous gold it is made from make it an invaluable piece of work, making it a coveted item not only for Summoners, but for many researchers who try to obtain it in order to gain knowledge from other worlds.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Multiplies Item drop rate by 1.5 after Raid Quest is cleared when activated from map
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A precious yellow box found recently within the Vortex. This box made of special materials contains a magical light from another world that when unleashed in battle raises the probability of obtaining rare and valuable items. The reason why demons want to make use of it remains unclear, but it has been confirmed that its magic envelops Summoners in a warm light.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Multiplies Item drop rate by 2 after Raid Quest is cleared when activated from map
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: An extremely rare orange coffer found recently within the Vortex. This box made of special materials contains a magical light from another world that when unleashed in battle greatly raises the probability of obtaining rare and valuable items. Some scholars speculate that the magical light this coffer releases is actually knowledge from another world that is passed on to whomever activates the item.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: 使用後３０分間、クエストクリア時の獲得経験値が１.５倍になる
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: アクラス召喚院で販売されている貴重な水。神秘的な霊力が籠められた霊水であり、召喚師が戦いの際に使用すると通常よりも多くの経験を得られるようになるという。独特の苦味のため当初は敬遠されていたが、その効果から駆け出しの召喚師を中心に人気が広まり、瞬く間に幅広い召喚師が愛用する飲料水として知られるようになった。

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: 使用後３０分間、クエストクリア時の獲得経験値が２倍になる
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: アクラス召喚院で販売されている、非常に貴重な水。神秘的な霊力が込められた霊水であり、召喚師が戦いの際に使用すると通常よりも遥かに多くの経験を得られるようになるという。霊水の入手元は機密として明かされていないが、召喚老の１人が若き召喚師たちの成長を促進するため、異界に渡って入手しているという噂が囁かれている。

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: クエストクリア時の獲得経験値が１.５倍になる
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: より多くの召喚師を効率よく育成するため、アクラス召喚院で新たに開発・販売されるようになった丸薬。異界の薬草をすり潰したものに経験の水を数滴ずつ混ぜ込んであり、召喚師が服用することで、一回きりではあるが多くの経験を得られるようになる。ただし薬草のせいで苦味が増しており、渋面を作る召喚師が増えているという。

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: クエストクリア時の獲得経験値が２倍になる

2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: ある魔神の中心核を用い作られたとされる霊薬。常飲すれば神に勝るとも劣らない力を得るが、精製に用いた魔神の中心核に謎が多く、副作用の心配もあることから現在はまだ試作段階である。召喚院のみならず連邦側も極秘裏に精製に関わっているとされ、連邦側の代表はこの霊薬の成果を見て「まずは第一歩だな」と呟いたという。

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: 全てのユニットの攻撃力・防御力を３０％アップ＆スパーク時、ＢＣ出現率をかなりアップ＆スパーク時、ＢＢゲージを少し増加
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: とある異界に人々の繁栄を司る神が存在した。その神は酒に目がなく、人間の口には合わない酒を好んで収集したという。その後、神は各地を巡りながら、酒を製造する土地には特に恵みをもたらしたと伝えられている。また噂によると、神が好む酒を飲み切った人間には神の力を授けられ、屈強な肉体と精神力を得られると言われている。

2C7LDzYk.c7Z6xDB2: 託閃煌鏡フォリフォリ
2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: 全てのユニットの攻撃力・防御力・最大ＨＰを５０％アップ＆スパーク時、ＢＣ出現率をかなりアップ・ＢＢゲージを増加＆与ダメージが一定数を超える度にＢＢゲージをかなり増加＆ＯＤゲージ上昇量をかなりアップ
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: ある国の皇族が神に認められ、与えられた聖鏡。その一族は神より国の統治を任されていたとされるが、代を経るごとにその権威は衰えていった。そんな中、魔神に侵略を受け、国が窮地に陥ってしまう。その代の皇帝は凡庸な人物であったが、この聖鏡を目にした瞬間に人が変わったように才気を発揮。軍を指揮して魔神を撃退したという。

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: 全てのユニットの最大ＨＰを２５％アップ＆炎・水・樹・雷属性ユニットからの被ダメージを１０％軽減
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: とある異界に聖神と呼ばれる神を祀る伝統行事がある。人々が聖神の分身である柴灯火を囲みながら、聖神に感謝の意を伝える聖祭である。伝承によると、柴灯火にはあらゆる災禍を焼き尽くす霊力が宿るとされ、その火を体に浴びた者は聖神の霊力の一部を賜るという。聖祭が終わると、柴灯火は美しい結晶に変化すると言われている。

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: ＨＰが半分以上の時、攻撃力・防御力・回復力をアップ＆光・闇属性からの被ダメージを１０％軽減＆ＨＣ獲得時の回復量アップ
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: 古代グランガイアにて、神々や魔神以外の存在を崇拝する集団が着用していたとされる装束。その信仰対象は神や魔神をも凌駕する力を持つ虹翼の竜であったと伝えられている。神々は彼らの勢力の拡大を恐れ侵攻を開始したが、力のある限り竜に祈りを捧げ続けた彼らの装束には神々の猛攻を蹴散らすほどの力が宿っていたという。

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: 全てのユニットの最大ＨＰを５０％アップ＆ＨＰが半分以上の時、攻撃力・防御力・回復力をかなりアップ＆全属性ユニットからの被ダメージを１０％軽減＆ＨＰが半分以下になる度に、３ターン、ターン毎にＨＰをかなり回復
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: 異界のとある神殿遺跡より発掘された聖遺物。この宝杯は人々の深い信仰心への褒賞として神が授けたものとされ、敬虔な信者が口付けると望む力が得られたとされた。人々は神々をますます信奉し、宝杯もまた信仰心に呼応するように力を増した。信仰の念は宝杯に溜まり続け、やがて神すらをも越える力を蓄えるに至ったとされている。

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: 戦闘開始から３ターン、攻撃力・防御力を１００％アップ＆ＢＣ獲得時の増加量アップ＆敵撃破時、ＢＢゲージを増加
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: 太古の昔、名匠が我が身を犠牲に太陽の光で鍛えたとされる名刀。闇の障壁を身に纏って無敵の強さを誇った魔神を討つために作られたもので、名匠は刀をある達人に託した。刀を見た魔神はそこに宿っている光の力は瞬く間に失われると嘲笑。だが、達人はその光が失われるまでの一瞬、一太刀で障壁ごと魔神を両断したという。

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A valuable piece of gold
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A shiny piece of gold that has been polished and shined by a craftsman, could be sold for a high value.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A valuable piece of polished crystal stone
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A prized piece of jewel that has been polished and shined by a craftsman, could be sold for a high value.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Coin that could fetch a decent amount of Zel
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A small rounded piece of gold, a trading substitute used by outlaws instead of Zel. Fetches decent amount of Zel.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A  rare glimmering hide. Unique crafting material.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: The hide of an ancient creature clear as a mirror, but which glimmers with immense colors. There had been rumors that the hide had come from an illusive creature of old that had the ability to vanish in an instant, rendering only the most skilled ancient hunters able to kill one. Some say it had been some sort of horse, but no one has been able to identify it. Once killed, its body incinerates to ashes leaving behind only its shiny hide.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: The chipped piece of a unicorn's horn. Unique crafting material.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: Chipped off from a unicorn's horn, this shard holds magical and medicinal properties. Herbalists grind it for medicine to cure diseases, while elemental craftsmen enchant accessories and weapons with its energy for increased luck and blessings.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: The chipped piece of a minotaur's horn. Unique crafting material.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: Chipped off from a minotaur's horn, the shard holds an aura of intense energy. It is said that being in contact with it for too long can affect one's mood and temper. Some artisans and craftsmen use its intense energy to strengthen armor and weapons.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: An extremely durable material mined from the depths of the earth. Unique crafting material.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: Adamite can be found in the depths of underground caverns, and is said to possess a mysterious energy harnessed from the earth's core. It is extremely durable and often mined for crafting battle armor, even though it is often hazardous to traverse deep into the earth.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: The remains of a fallen star. Unique crafting material.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: As falling stars blaze through the heavens, they smash into the land's surface with such force that they disintegrate into fine dust. Conjurers and healers often harvest it, as it contains cosmic energy that can greatly enhance their craft. Common folk keep it in a bottle as a blessing from the heavens.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Pure water infused with lunar magic
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: Clear water infused with lunar energy throughout a long, clear night sky. There is a legend of the full moon staring at its own reflection on the stagnant water surface. Mesmerized by its own beauty, it silently transferred some of its spirit into its own reflection.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A pouch filled with cooking necessities
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: Spice pouches are usually prepared by travelling merchants and peddlers, filled with various cooking ingredients and seasoning. They are often traded to adventurers as a travelling necessity for spicing up their meals while traversing for days outfield before reaching their destination. Having a good meal is great for the mind and soul!

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A type of firefly that glows in the shimmering yellow hue of the moon
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: This typical type of firefly emerges every year during the fullest moon, attracted to the intense lunar energies projected from the night sky. Their mysterious yellow glow is rumored to be some sort of communication through the astral field where the moon's consciousness resides.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: An undying flame that doesn't burn nor scotch
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: Undying flames are said to combust mystically out of nowhere during certain times of the year when astral energies in the air are overwhelming. They can be shifted and moved by physical bodies and objects. These mysterious flames draw their aura from alternate dimensions that are filled with unlimited amounts of energy across the Vortex. Some adventurers prefer it as a light source due to its dim glow that doesn't attract attention.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Drop formed from the dew around the area where the Vortex emerges
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: As the Vortex emerges through summonings and the crossing of planes by Summoners, its elemental aura energizes the droplets around it, causing their purity to shimmer. They are hard to come by, but are said to have revitalizing powers.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Lunar Treat
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A revitalizing festive treat that is enjoyed by all.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Mooncake
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A traditional Mid-Autumn festive treat. A revitalizing and indispensable delicacy.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Crescent Dew
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: Also known as "Tears of the Moon." A drop of this Crescent Dew into the eye of a fallen hero could initiate a moonlit revival.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: The bone of a deceased cursed one. Unique event crafting material.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: Cursed bones are usually found near places where powerful evils reside. Once belonging to heroes and commoners alike, they are now what remains of the cursed and marked for death.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: The remains of a fallen star. Unique crafting material.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A drop of evil that comes from a powerful dark being. It harnesses the essence of mischief, fear, insanity and folly.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: The remains of a fallen evil being. Unique crafting material.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: Dust filled with evil essence, the burnt remains of a once powerful evil being.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Candy Treat
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: Trick or Treat! Trick or Treat!!! Candy is good for health. It's customary to give treats to children in costumes when they visit your house. Don't forget to give them a scare as well!

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Memory Fragment
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A strange piece of glowing crystal that holds a rare power. It was created from the memories of a Knight of Grandshelt who is eager to defend her friends, no matter where their travels may take them.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Scroll of Black Arts
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A scroll containing forbidden magic.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Radiant Quartz
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A special quartz infused with elemental power and radiates a soothing aura

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: 50% boost to Atk, Def, Rec for all allies on the map for 5 minutes. Up to 4 may be used simultaneously.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A chunk of rock retrieved from the remains of an Orebi Revenant. Its unassuming appearance belies its innate magical properties that can only be harnessed by a Summoner.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A pretty snow flake, cool to the touch. Unique event crafting material.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A snow flake that shines softly with a blue glow. Mystical energy surrounds it.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Crystal shards that are synthesized with mystical Snow Flakes. Unique event crafting material.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: These crystal shards are the work of condensing mystical Snow Flakes together. They glow blue and have an aura of mysterious energy surrounding them.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A gemstone filled with the frozen essence of magic. Unique event crafting material.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: Snow Gemstones are crafted through the tedious work of synthesizing Snow Crystals with extreme precision. The technique used to cut these chilled crystal stones causes them to reflect light as if they illuminate themselves. A precious material sought by ice mages.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A frosted drop of condensed winter essence with magical properties. Unique event crafting material.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: During the day when the sun comes out and melts the ice and snow a little, sudden gusts of chilling storm winds flash freeze these melting dews. The mysterious and magical ice glades then keep the frozen dew from melting ever again.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: The frozen heart of a creature. Unique event crafting material.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: Frozen hearts are rare to find, and can only be found on creatures that thrive in harsh, cold lands. For as long as they have survived, their hearts have slowly crystalized, changing them into cold and vicious creatures. Arctic hunters laugh at the irony of vicious creatures having a beautiful heart, for frozen hearts glimmer with a mystical beauty.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: The frigid soul of a beast, frozen through dark arts and magic. Unique event crafting material.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: They say that when beings have passed on, their souls leave their bodies to another dimension and place. But some souls that have been cursed and trapped by powerful arcane masters before death are not able to redeem themselves, remaining imprisoned and frozen for eternity.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Candy Cane
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: ITEMS_BATTLEITEMS_800206_LONGDESCRIPTION

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A gemstone filled with good wishes. Extremely valuable when sold, but also a unique synthesis material.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: Aspiration stones are enchanted gemstones of an unknown element which bear immense beauty. It is rumored that they are synthesized and blessed by the gods themselves, eventually scattered by them across the lands. They are of valuable worth and many are willing to pay a high price to get one, believing that possessing the item brings great luck. Craftsmen are known to synthesize them into powerful artifacts with the right ingredients.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Peppermint Stick
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A delicious pepper flavored treat for those with a sweet tooth. It is a snack most fitting of the holiday season.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Typically used as a household ornament, this wreath is a symbol of winter's festive spirit.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: Typically used as a household ornament, this wreath is a merry decoration used by people to celebrate the festivities of the winter season. Some claim that the holidays can prove rather dull without one.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Filled with toys, candy, and other goodies, this bag contains an assortment of enjoyable presents.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: Filled with toys, candies, and other goodies, this bag is full of presents that fill the heart with joy. One is certain to receive at least one of the gifts waiting inside, even if its just a lump of coal!

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A small toy in the shape of a soldier. It bears a strong resemblance to a mysterious figure.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A small wooden toy shaped like a soldier standing at attention. Curiously, it bears a strong resemblance to a mysterious figure. It serves many boys and girls quite well in their little games, and gives parents peace of mind as it stands vigilant against the terrors of the night.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A shiny badge for those who have proven their courage.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A shiny badge made to adorn the chest of those who have proven their courage. Regardless of its design, it is worn by young and old alike.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A recovered stolen packet. Redeem at your nearest merchant for Zel!
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A monetary token traditionally presented at social and family gatherings during the Chinese New Year.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A recovered stolen packet. Redeem at your nearest merchant for Zel!
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A monetary token traditionally presented at social and family gatherings during the Chinese New Year.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A recovered stolen packet. Redeem at your nearest merchant for Zel!
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A monetary token traditionally presented at social and family gatherings during the Chinese New Year.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: An auspicious artifact. Unique event crafting material.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: An auspicious artifact believed to bring good luck to any home that houses it.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Mandarin Orange
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A tasty festive fruit enjoyed by all.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Nian Gao
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A tasty festive treat. People believe that eating Nian Gao during this festive season brings them greater fortune and luck all year long.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A symbol of ripe old age. Unique event crafting material.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A mythic dew that is formed by the hopes and dreams of generations of aspiring hard working people. No one knows how it is formed, but the one who posses it is said to enjoy life a little while longer.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: All you need is a pinch of this to make it big. Unique event crafting material.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: As a new year approaches, the wind brings along a wave of pink mist in the air. Many harvest the pink mist and crystalize it into an essence, forging a gemstone that invites good luck and prosperity.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Jem Replica created by Nice Burny
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: Jem Replica created by Nice Burny

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: This charm brings happiness and good fortune to the bearer.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: This charm brings happiness and good fortune to the bearer. In ancient times it was also a symbol used to ward off evil spirits.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Coins such as thesehave a long history of bringing good luck.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: Coins such as these have a long history of bringing good luck. Popular belief has it that coins with a hole in them bring even more luck!

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A feather dropped from the most majestic of birds.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A feather dropped from the most majestic of birds. Myth has it that you can harness the power of life from them.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Fortune Cookie
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A crispy cookie that contains words of wisdom. Some swear by the prophecies they obtain from them.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Pineapple Tart
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A tasty pastry for those with a sweet tooth. Pineapple tarts symbolize that prosperity is arriving!

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Fills Overdrive Gauge by 20%
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A traditional fruit used to bring good luck and prosperity to all!

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Nyami's Pudding
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: Painstakingly crafted by the finest chef in Eneroth for the annual National Artistic Candy League. Nyami hid under the judges' table for three days and three nights before managing to swipe it out of the Queen's hands. She managed to barely escape by throwing premium quality salt into the eyes of the royal guards, making a clean getaway!

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A salt crystal obtained from the depths of Grand Gaia.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: The finest salt obtained from the depths of Grand Gaia. Legends say that the salt deposits of Grand Gaia grow larger every time a special gate opens.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A pure white flower. Unique event crafting material.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A beautiful flower that is commonly used as decoration during celebrations.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A deacon's bell. Unique event crafting material.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A bell that, when rang, is said to raise the spirits of all who hear it.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Believed to bring the bearer good luck!  Unique event crafting material.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: Folklore says if you collect enough of it; something good will happen, just remember it didn't work for the rabbit.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Rainbow Cupcake
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A delicious, colourful cupcake that is found lying around. Some people say a mysterious hare in clothing leaves them behind.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Adorned Egg
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A jewelled egg crafted by a famous goldsmith of otherworldly skills. Opening one reveals a hidden surprise that is sure to delight the beholder.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A sweet concoction that shines with the unmistakeable hint of magic.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A sweet concoction that shines with the unmistakeable hint of magic. Some people have used to make desserts for a special holiday that has been lost to the mists of time.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A tart candy that shines with the unmistakeable hint of magic.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A tart candy that shines with the unmistakeable hint of magic. Consuming too many of these may cause tooth decay, gum problems, and mild flights of fancy.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A special egg that glows with the unmistakeable hint of magic.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A special egg that glows with the unmistakeable hint of magic. Kindly handle this with caution, and whatever you do, do not use it to make scrambled eggs.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A nutritious vegetable that contains concentrated amounts of magic.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A nutritious vegetable that contains concentrated amounts of magic. Do not feed this to cybernetic bunnies, unless you have their firmware update ready.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: The special component to making your very own mechanized bunny.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: The special component to making your very own mechanized bunny. Remember to pet it gently, stroke its ears, and feed it often, lest it decides to deploy its weapons against you.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Carrot Cake
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A delicious slice of a dessert best savored slowly with tea. Of course, you can't have just one slice now, can you?

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Mystical Eggs
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: Specially decorated eggs that have the sheen of magic in them. You can find them all over Grand Gaia, but be warned: they can give you the ride of your life.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A hardy stone that protects its bearer.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A hardy stone that protects its bearer. It draws strength on its owner's desire to protect others, and thus cracks easily when they are found lacking.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: The ashes of burnt spiritwood trees.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: The ashes of burnt spiritwood trees said to be imbued with a holy power, and to protect those who pray for their hopes and dreams.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A large crystal fueled by esper energy.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A large crystal fueled by esper energy. They are quite rare and only activate when heroes are nearby.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A mysterious powder left by spirits in their wake.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A mysterious powder left by spirits in their wake. It is said to reveal both one's future and fears when it is burnt.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A heavy crystal fueled by esper energy.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A heavy crystal fueled by esper energy. They are extremely rare and said to only call out to those deemed worthy.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A strangely glowing crystal that holds a memory of courage.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A strangely glowing crystal that holds a memory of courage belonging to a Knight of Grandshelt. It evokes memories of friendship, laughter, and home.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Lucky Potion
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A potion that brings luck to those who consume it.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Dark Flask
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A sinister-looking mixture that offers protection against Dark energy.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Dark Vial
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: An ominous concoction that protects Summoners and common people alike from Dark forces.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A magical flower that glows bright in the face of true love.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: This magical flower glows bright in the face of true love. The stronger the bonds of love, the brighter the glow.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A magical bow that glows when wielded by the pure of heart.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A magical bow that glows when wielded by the pure of heart. First wielded by a famous archer by the name of Cupid, it is said that he always strike true.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A magical arrow that strikes through the hearts of its targets.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A magical arrow that strikes through the hearts of its targets. Seemingly harmless, this arrow is known to be able to string two targets together.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: An embroidered handkerchief from the kingdom of Krung-go.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: In the kingdom of Krung-go, many artisans still practice the art of hand embroidery. A pair of mandarin ducks is a symbol of love and marriage.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: One half of a love pendant, lonely and incomplete.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Love Pendant
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A pair of matching heart pendants.Together they fit perfectly and complement each other. Often given as a symbol of love between partners.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Chocolates
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A tasty bite sized decadent chocolate that is loved by all ages.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Box of Chocolates
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A box of chocolate coated snacks rumored to be both delicious, and full of surprises.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A unique pin used to stylishly bind several materials together.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A unique pin used to stylishly bind several materials together. It is said that only a few crafters know how to make that special flowery flourish.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A bullet with an inscription of a heart, it is said to symbolize a gunpowder romance.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A bullet with an inscription of a heart, it is said to symbolize a gunpowder romance. Some, of course, have said that it is an omen of a fiery shotgun wedding.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A brilliantly colored crystal that glows with power.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A brilliantly colored crystal that glows with power. Strangely enough, it is said to smell like roses when sniffed--a hazardous choice, considering that it is known to be abrasive to one's lungs.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A special set of documents detailing how to build a unique set of weapons.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A special set of documents detailing how to build a unique set of weapons. Some of these plans require materials that are literally out of this world.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A special document detailing one's marriage to a very enthusiastic candidate.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A special document detailing one's marriage to a very enthusiastic candidate. A careful reading of the terms reveals several strange requirements, such as "must be able to outrun bullets, shockwaves, and explosions."

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A crystallized shard of power crafted from pure fire.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A crystallized shard of power crafted from pure fire. It is used in increasing the power of a hero beyond their known limits - and beyond.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A crystallized shard of power crafted from pure ice.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A crystallized shard of power crafted from pure ice. It is used in increasing the power of a hero beyond their known limits - and beyond.

2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A crystallized shard of power crafted from pure shadow. It is used in increasing the power of a hero beyond their known limits - and beyond.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: This tome of elemental power unlocks a hero's potential within.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: This tome of elemental power unlocks a hero's potential within. With the right components, one can become a legend in their own right - or even more.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: This tome of greater elemental power unlocks a hero's potential within.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: This tome of greater elemental power unlocks a hero's potential within. With the right components, one can become a legend in their own right - or even more.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Recovers HP each turn & slightly reduces BB gauge used during BB
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A cross shaped wand, used by Mira, a nun known as the "Beansprouts Sister" from the fabled world of elder runes. This wand can be used to channel restorative powers to keep its owner in good health. It is also known to boost the potential of its bearer, granting them endurance that helps them perform vigorous attacks more easily. However, any details regarding its history and origins remain unknown.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A glowing, rectangular object that is warm to the touch.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A glowing, rectangular object that is warm to the touch. It can be used to power a variety of devices. Do not shake or overcharge.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A mysteriously heavy device that is strangely warm to the touch.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A mysteriously heavy device that is strangely warm to the touch. Some say that they can hear a humming sound when they listen to it closely.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A strange device that lets you see faraway things with ease.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A strange device that lets you see faraway things with ease. It's surprisingly easy to carry - and just as easy to lose.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A mechanical device that has been engineered to perfection.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A mechanical device that has been engineered to perfection, it can do a variety of tasks with precise timing. Clean it often.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A form of Lacrima infused with the power of Fire, it feels warm to the touch.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A form of Lacrima infused with the power of Fire, it feels warm to the touch.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A form of Lacrima infused with the power of Water, it feels cool to the touch.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A form of Lacrima infused with the power of Water, it feels cool to the touch.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A form of Lacrima infused with the power of Earth, it feels soft to the touch.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A form of Lacrima infused with the power of Thunder, it feels electrifying to the touch.

2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A form of Lacrima infused with the power of Darkness, it feels cold to the touch.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A strange, black substance that emits a pungent and aromatic scent.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A strange, black substance that emits a pungent and aromatic scent. Those who catch a whiff of the dark ooze are often thrown into an entranced state.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A rare metallic ore that is highly prized due its malleability and luster.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A rare metallic ore that is highly prized due its malleability and luster. Due to its resemblance to gold, it is often used to craft trinkets of all kinds.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A handful of luck.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A lock of hair.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_801015_LONGDESCRIPTION

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A brightly gleaming stone containing trace amounts of Faefire.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: Legends tell of a divine source of fire granted to the Fae, the first people to walk the land of Aimyhr. The great Starsage Zeruiah was prudent with this power, for its destructive capability was second to none.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: An eerily glowing stone containing trace amounts of Void.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: When the Voidborn swarmed into Aimyhr, they brought with them an otherworldly blight known as the Void.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Slightly hot to the touch, brilliant hues of gold and red flame dance within this mineral containing concentrated Faefire.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: Faefire was granted as a blessing to Baelfyr, leader of the Kingdoms of Man, in a bid to protect Aimyhr from their otherworldly invaders.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Ghostly hues of purple and white swirl within this mineral containing concentrated Void.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: This material appears to be an offshoot of the Ravaging Void, a cataclysmic force that existed around the same time as the earliest touch of life upon the universe. This eternal struggle of life and death—between the all-consuming Void and the rebirth of new life in endless cycles—has existed since the very beginning.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: The veiled drop of Akachi, overflowing with cosmic energy.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: The veiled drop of Akachi, overflowing with cosmic energy. A drop of this grants immense knowledge.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: The occult fang of Akachi, overflowing with cosmic energy.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: The occult fang of Akachi, overflowing with cosmic energy. The fang can pierce even the hardest material known to man.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: The mystic stone of Akachi, overflowing with cosmic energy.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: The mystic stone of Akachi, overflowing with cosmic energy. Armor made from this material can withstand the fiercest of blows.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: The psychic eye of Akachi, overflowing with cosmic energy.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: The psychic eye of Akachi, overflowing with cosmic energy. The bearer of this eye sees all, and knows all.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: MST_EVOITEM_801900_SHORTDESCRIPTION
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: MST_EVOITEM_801900_LONGDESCRIPTION

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A brittle mineral rumored to be the solidified blood of fallen gods, it pulses with magical power.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A brittle mineral rumored to be the solidified blood of fallen gods, it pulses with magical power. But very few people know how to harness it properly. Used correctly, it can fuel magical arts that can change the world.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: An obsidian shard that contains the spirit of Mannag. Resonates wtih Kielazar's soul.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: An obsidian shard containing the spirit of Mannag, Kielazar's loyal wolfhound companion. The polished surface radiates with spectral energy, and those especially attuned to the supernatural may be able to hear a faint howling within. Mannag never fails to answer his master's call. In a way, both master and hound have become one in spirit.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Broken crystal pieces that radiates a warm power.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: Broken crystal pieces that radiate a warm, comforting aura. These crystallites appear to be able to absorb harmful energies when exposed to them. Theodor also postulates they could be used as a catalyst if combined with the right materials…

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Luminous liquid in bottles radiating a warm power.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: Bottles containing luminous liquids that radiate a warm, comforting aura. They appear to be ordinary—if colourful—liquids, but based on his observations and experiments, Theodor concludes that these are solvents used to heighten the powers of magical items.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A variety of notes, each contained within a small orb.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A variety of notes, each contained within a small orb. These orbs exude an aura of coldness, a fact that many people find puzzling, considering their appearance.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A variety of notes, each contained within a small orb.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A variety of notes, each contained within a small orb. These orbs exude an aura of coldness, a fact that many people find puzzling, considering their appearance.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Vektor special engineered Flux. Used for Excelsior Chip.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L:
This specially engineered flux is one of Vektor's crowning achievements. Boasting a Class-S bond strength, it is up to a hundred times stronger than most industrial variants. It can however be easily dissolved by using any good unbonding agent on the market. making mistakes less deadly than they would be.

Bearing a striking similarity to hair styling products, some claim that Vektor might have used this for his gravity-proof coiffure. He vehemently denies this when asked.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Vektor special engineered Lead. Used for Excelsior Chip.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L:
This specially crafted spool of lead is used exclusively for the Excelsior series of items that Vektor has lovingly engineered. An important component in any form of electronics, lead creates a bond between contact points. The Excelsior type exceeds all other market types in both durability and conductivity, somehow even positively enhancing the appliance itself.

When questioned on the specifics of how the lead increases performance, Vektor simply winks and say it is a trade secret.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Broken chip. Can be restored with Excelsior materials.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L:
This broken chip was once installed in Galene as a modular enhancement to her combat capabilities. However, during her escape from the Corporation, Galene inadvertently destroyed the chip by overloading it during combat with the Security System.

Although it is currently unusable, it can certainly be restored with enough materials on hand.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Appearing as an unremarkable stone at first, closer examination reveals the scintillation hidden within its dark depths.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: Appearing as an unremarkable—albeit beautiful—stone at first, closer examination reveals the scintillation hidden within its dark depths. As they shine under the keen eye of the observer, one cannot help but sense that something alien is watching them in return. But it's probably just a figment of one's imagination...

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: To the uninitiated, these look like clothing fit for royalty.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: To the uninitiated, these may look like clothing fit for royalty--nothing more. But to the discerning eye, these artifacts contain unlimited power that can be tapped by those chosen by divinity. Of course, to gain such a blessing is an adventure in itself...

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Crafted from roughly-hewn pieces of precious rock, these stones pulse with power that they can barely contain.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: Crafted from roughly-hewn pieces of precious rock, these stones pulse with power that they can barely contain. Many who desire glory and success are naturally drawn to these, unaware that the very jewels they covet have an agenda of their own.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Boosts Def by 360% when Unit's HP drops below 35% & slight boost to BC drop rate when attacking
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: During Leon's early days as a thief, brushes with death had made him realize the importance of survival. He designed a Guardian Cloak that could save him in times of need.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Boosts Def by 330% for the first 2 turns & BB gauge fills faster when obtaining BC
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: The magic of the Aegis Cloak is that it gives enemies the illusion of a clean attack while the offense is greatly directed away from the bearer's body.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Boost Atk, Def, Rec, and max HP by15% & slight critical rate up
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A mysterious lantern with an undying flame. Infused with arcane powers that cause it to glow more brightly under a full moon.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Boost Atk by 25%, Def, Rec and max HP by 20% & adds high chance of reflecting partial enemy damage
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A ring of power granted by the gods to challengers who have demonstrated their strength through various trials. It empowers the bearer with great strength, hardened defenses and the ability to mirror damage back against any foe.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Greatly boosts drop rate of BC when attacking & deals extra normal attacks
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A skull cursed with the restless souls of warriors who lost their lives in the battle of La Veda. A Wicker Man is said to have been guarding it, waiting for the right bearer to grasp it...

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Boosts BB gauge when attacking & deals extra normal attacks
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: An artifact that grants it's wielders a tremendous surge in necrotic wrath. Each year for centuries, during the season when wails accompanied by the howling of wolves can be heard, it is said that this orb glows with hate...

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Reduces the consumption of BB gauge, boosts Def and max HP by 10% & boosts Atk and Rec by 5%
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: An ornament belonging to a nefarious ruler who once stood alongside the great disciples of Grand Gaia. Over time, corruption and greed consumed him and he craved death more than being a part of a greater cause. After shattering his camaraderie, he ran into exile, in search for his calling.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Greatly boosts BC drop rate when attacking, raises normal hit amount & 30% boost to Atk and Def
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: There are many stories about the origins of this skull. The most common one is that it belonged to a demon who died in an ancient war. Previous bearers have all been rewarded with great strength, and eventually descendedinto madness...

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Damage dealt boosts BB gauge, raises normal hit amount & boosts critical damage
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: Rumor has it that this artifact was found on an altar in an underground labyrinth by a group of explorers. As the leader touched the orb, he lost consciousness. When he woke up, he found that his entire party has disappeared,andin his hands was the same orb, now with shadowy figures that seemed like theyweretrapped within...

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: 20% boost to Def, max HP, 5% damage reduction & negates status ailments
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A weapon forged from memories and relics from a faraway home, this item glows with the light of the otherworldly might found within. A soft hum can be heard whenever it is held by heroes with good hearts, bound by courage and friendship to defend the world against evil.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Damage dealt enormously boosts Karma, Item drop rates & boosts BB gauge each turn
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A mysterious gooey substance that oozed out from a strange egg-like object discovered in a pipe from one of Noel's research labs, after a massive water leakage incident had erupted overnight. The goo got devoured by a certain hungry jewel ghost that always tried to sell itself to charity. The next morning, lab personnel were amazed to discover a shiny Golden God blocking the hallway to Noel's chamber.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Boosts HP and Atk by 15%, Def and Rec by 20% & adds chance of slight HP recovery when damaged
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A mystical snowglobe infused with the essence of winter and its magic.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Boosts HP and Atk by 20%, Def and Rec by 30% & adds chance of BB gauge boost when damaged
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: The Frozen Myth had long been deemed to be just a legendary stone that people called "The Heart of Winter." It freezes the air around it and is said to bear the soul of the cold season itself. No man can ever hold it with their bare hands as its frost burns any mortal flesh.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Good boost to BC, HC, Zel, Karma, and Item drop rate
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A frosted and enchanted gemstone which emits a swirling blurred glow from the inside. Although cool to the touch, it warms the heart and soul of the bearer, giving him great spirit and energy.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Boosts HP and Atk by 30%, Def and Rec by 40% & probable BB gauge boost when damaged
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: Long deemed unconquerable by mere mortals. The stone was lost to the deep wintertide. In one of the coldest winters known to date, it was discove255:0:0 by a duo who came across it in a forgotten cave, as if being called out by it. Both were immediately ensna255:0:0 by its power and a great battle for ownership ensued. In the morning, only one walked out of the cave. The direction taken, however, was not towards home but deeper into the wintertide.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: 20% boost to all parameters, damage taken may restore HP & reduces BB gauge required for BB
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A small, almost unremarkable chunk of gold shaped vaguely like a heart, it contains many warm memories and happy thoughts tempered by a cruel world. The light shining brightly deep within can make even the saddest hearts happy once again. When placed in a toy soldier's chest, it can make him a real boy--almost.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: 20% boost to all parameters & boosts BC, HC, Karma drop rates
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A lifetime of happy holiday memories made whole with a beautiful ornament crafted from precious jewels and metals. Legend has it that the shine of this lovely relic can even make wishes come true, albeit for a limited time. Could there be any truth behind this myth? After all, winter nights are said to be the most magical of all...

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: 30% boost to all parameters, boosts BC, HC, Karma, Item drop rates & reduces damage taken from Dark types
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A lifetime of cheerful holiday memories warmed by the sun, the power within this relic reminds its bearer that there are always things worth fighting for. Its shine can be so intense at times that it can even be used as an improvised lantern, bringing quite a literal meaning to the phrase "light can always be found in the darkest of places."

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: 40% boost to all parameters, boosts BC, HC, Karma, Item drop rates, damage taken may restore HP & reduces damage taken from Water, Dark types
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A lifetime of cheerful holiday memories that glows in the darkest nights, the sun-touched power within this relic can even bring inanimate objects to life, albeit for a limited time. Even in the coldest of nights, its power is proof of miracles - but only if one believes in the joy of the season.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Boosts max HP and Atk by 30%, Def by 15%, boosts BC drop rate & boosts Def against Dark elemental damage
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A special sword forged from Mithril by royal Elysian blacksmiths. It was given to Xenon as a token of honor from the Elysian King for dedicating his life as a protector of the realm.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Boosts Atk by 100%, critical hit damage by 50%. Lowers Def & Rec by 20%
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: An ancient piece of parchment inscribed with a litany in an unknown language which has been kept hidden by the Battle Maidens, and passed down from generation to generation. Its seal pulsates with a dark energy that slowly consumes the bearer's mind, eventually driving them to madness. Vanila has entrusted this dark relic to you, fearing that Lico would one day be consumed by her already unnatural bloodlust should it fall into her hands...

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh:
BB gauge refills slightly faster, slightly reduces the consumption of BB gauge & chance of
inflicting Poison, Weakness, Injury, Paralysis
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: After upgrading her cannon, Bonnie left behind a strange mechanical contraption before bouncing off into the woods. Engineers from Randall began studying the gadget, hoping to create an alloy of unprecedented strength. Their experiments were fraught with many perils. While they failed to achieve their goal, they did manage to replicate and apply some mysterious properties to an extent. The results were the weapon enhancers that could manipulate weight and strike any target with a mild, weakening electrical charge.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Boost to all stats by 20% & boosts BB gauge every turn
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: Using techniques developed by the Master Smiths of Athensphere, an incredibly dense ore of unkown origins was forged into a massive warhammer. The process was said to have been so intense that the Scared Forge was left in a state beyond repair, thus its name Forgebreaker. Forgebreaker was gifted to Deimos by Zedus, inrecognition of his unrivalled strength and pledge of loyalty. Every blow from Forgehammer sounded like a massive clap of thunder, shattering the ground in its immediate vicinity. It is rumored that the ore was obtained from the Void itself and within it houses an unimmaginable amount of raw energy. The mysterious energy from the warhammer is believed to grant its bearer extraordinary stamina, allowing Deimos to fight for days on end.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Boost to Atk by 80% & chance of damage taken being decreased by 30%
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A small jet black sphere no bigger than the fist of young child retrieved from the site of the void rift. The occasional flash of purple light from the sphere reveals a highly intricate network of lines carved underneath its smooth surface. Gazia created this power amplifier to boost Zenia's abilities exponentially. It was specifically designed to forcefully "awaken" Zenia's potential at manipulating the gates across worlds. With the power amplifier activated, it grants it's bearer unmatched physical capabilities, at the risk of damaging one's own body permernantly.

In a flash of understanding, Ma'at drew on the magics of Neith, infusing Set with a power unlike any other at the moment of her birth. A sha was recorded to enter the room and immediately snuggled down next to baby Set, her companion for life.

Initially trapped by the vast expanse of blue surrounding the island he arrived on, a first encounter with a rolling wave soon replaced that trepidation with transcendence.

Her view of her rivals was thus: "For all his plans, Maestron has proven to be utterly predictable in his schemes. As for his pawns, they are too easily bought off with a breathy promise - weak worms."

Some believe that the aegis held the power of immortality, and that he only died because the aegis was taken from him, though there hasn't been concrete evidence to prove this.

An exorcist used the fang to create a barrier to ward off beasts from disturbing the graves of the villagers.

It is said that its wearer can hear her singing, like a soft whisper, when they are physically or spiritually weak.

The amulet was found among the ruins of war, and though the impact of battle had weakened its effects, it was still respected by warriors across the land, as it symbolized the clan's contributions during the war.

2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A pungent chocolate said to be only given to the pure-hearted young of Randall by the guardians in the skies. It is a rare and precious Item that should be cherished.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A beautiful flower that shines in seven different colors
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A mysterious rainbow colored flower found deep in the forest where Bonnie headed. Rumors say the essence of this flower supplies the luminous energy for Bonnie's cannon.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A fleshy tail from a massive serpent that is wet to the touch.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: Acquired from the Ulnhann's serpents and carefully preserved with nutri-liquid, these tails are then processed for their curative properties. They are known to accelerate tissue and bone growth, turning months of healing into mere days.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: An inflexible scale from a mature wyrm that makes a soft clinking sound.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: These scales are obtained by Vharag riders once their mounts begin to shed their skin. Flexible and easy to shape at first, they quickly harden as they dry into their new form. After some additional treatment, the scales become harder than steel, and equally as sharp.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A blue flower that glows softly under the right conditions.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: These freshly-picked blooms are prized by the Greherd for their hallucinogenic properties, especially during their first glow. Grown in their greenhouses together with other poisonous plants, they are often dried and added to battle stimulants to enhance their effects. They tend to cause dehydration, irregular bowel movements, and severe muscle spasms if improperly used.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A skull of a small animal reinforced with scraps of metal.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A primitive bludgeon made from a monster's dried thighbone. It is the first weapon a Khree warrior learns to master from childhood. Once it has been bathed in the blood of sufficient victims, it is typically ground to a fine powder and used as an ingredient in battle curatives.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: An eerie glowing bone. Unique event crafting material.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: These eerie bones are said to have a strange and dark power within them. Items crafted from these bones give great power to those able to wield them.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A sticky piece of the shambler plant, freshly cut.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: Obtained from live shamblers, these vines are quickly preserved in nutri-liquid to ensure that they stay fresh. Highly prized for their ability to adhere to any surface and act as an improvised pump, shambler cuttings are prized in Vardket bio-mechanical constructs, especially for building circulation and muscle systems.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A tough, barbed stinger from phrun shuttlebugs.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: Unlike most organic material obtained by the forces of the Vardket, phrun stingers only require that one lay small pieces of raw meat near shuttlebug nests to harvest a sizeable number for various uses. The stingers are then pulled out and cleaned before being used for a variety of items, such as arrowheads and climbing gear.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A piece of wood obtained from the burbur tree.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: Harvested from burbur trees by highly trained (and heavily armored) professionals, these pieces of wood are dried over the course of several days to reduce the potency of their man-killing sap to a slightly more tolerable form. Accidental ingestion of the final product tends to result in a longand painful demise, hencethe common tactic to load its powdered form in artillery shells.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A pair of fangs extracted from the centipedes found near burbur trees.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: Taken from the centipedes that are found around burbur trees, these steel-hard fangs are useful in ensuring that sorcerous armaments never lose their potency with time. While harvesting them does take a significant amount of effort and risk (plus a torn limb here and there), some feel that the benefits greatly outweigh the costs.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: A soft tail taken from the dhlerp, tough and sinewy.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: A soft tail taken from the dhlerp, tough and sinewy. It can be used to reinforce muscles and joints with the right materials.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Sand infused with the essence of time, it glitters in odd circumstances.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: Sand infused with the essence of time, it glitters in odd circumstances. Specialized equipment is necessary to handle it in order to avoid contamination incidents.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: An organic crystal grown from special farms deep underwater.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: An organic crystal grown from special farms deep underwater that is used as a cheap battery for flesh-implanted enchantments.

2C7LDzYk.qp37xTDh: Chains forged from volcanic lava that resist and dispel any magic.
2C7LDzYk.ZC0msu2L: Chains forged from volcanic lava that resist and dispel any magic. When used incorrectly, however, they can sever a soul from a body.
